purpose_zh: 把三处重点区从同一图形语法区分为三种可读的空间交接拓扑；节点关系是本方案的相对空间建议，不是测绘、实际站点、道路红线或工程落位。
purpose_en: Distinguish the three key areas as three legible spatial handover topologies. Node relationships are relative design proposals, not survey data, actual station siting, road redlines or engineering layouts.
shared_boundary_zh: 三个重点区均继承 provisional polygon；图中方向和尺度仅服务于各站内部关系，不表示测量方位或实际比例。
shared_boundary_en: All three key areas inherit provisional polygons. Diagram direction and scale serve only internal relationships and do not state surveyed orientation or actual scale.

stations.critical_boundary_zh: 安静居住、共享庭院、受控工作与服务到达沿同一公共门槛依次分开。
stations.critical_boundary_en: Quiet living, shared court, controlled work and service arrival are separated in sequence along one public threshold.

stations.critical_boundary_zh: 照护檐廊与共享庭院组织可变居住，服务在住户控制的私宅门槛之前停止。
stations.critical_boundary_en: A care porch and shared court organize adaptable living; service stops before the resident-controlled private threshold.

stations.critical_boundary_zh: 抵达方向汇入第一把钥匙和选项厅，再分别进入住房、工位与城市服务；三种决定不合并。
stations.critical_boundary_en: Arrival approaches meet at the First Key and option hall, then separate toward housing, workspace and city services; the three decisions never merge.

integrity_rules: Three topology values must be distinct.
Every station must declare at least four nodes and a critical boundary.
Every station must reference its provisional key-area feature.
No node may be represented as an official coordinate, survey point or approved project.
